name: Lemon Cherry Gelato Cartridge | 1g
description: Sour citrusy overtones are paired with fruity cherry and berry undertones in this delightfully delicious strain from the famed Gelato lineage. You'll enjoy a boost of happy energy at the onset, that quickly turns into a stoney relaxing bliss.
